name: Miyake (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Miyake village emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs open at the top, enclosing a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Miyake, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 June 1969.

features.role: Miyake village emblem — a ring of concentric arcs open at the top, enclosing a small disc
